rights.title: THE LAMB
rights.author: William Blake

source_text:
Little lamb, who made thee?
Does thou know who made thee,
Gave thee life, and bid thee feed
By the stream and o’er the mead;
Gave thee clothing of delight,
Softest clothing, woolly, bright;
Gave thee such a tender voice,
Making all the vales rejoice?
    Little lamb, who made thee?
    Does thou know who made thee?

Little lamb, I’ll tell thee;
Little lamb, I’ll tell thee:
He is callèd by thy name,
For He calls Himself a Lamb.
He is meek, and He is mild,
He became a little child.
I a child, and thou a lamb,
We are callèd by His name.
    Little lamb, God bless thee!
    Little lamb, God bless thee!

No ESRGAN weights are installed, and none were downloaded. sd-cli can be asked for 1600 or 2048 pixels on a side; both are multiples of 8 and within the 2400-pixel generator limit. Z-Image Turbo has produced 2400×2400 on this machine, so those sizes are inside a resolution it has already reached. RealVisXL V5.0 is an SDXL checkpoint reviewed at 1024×1024. This pack does not interpolate the approved image and does not replace it with a new sample. A larger native file would be a separate generation, not extra detail inside this file.
